title: Progress bar vanishes at 120 cols when the verdict summary is long
body:
dashProgressLine drops the whole bar when bar + counts + verdict exceed the pane, instead of truncating the verdict summary. A stopped or degraded run's summary routinely does this at 120 columns, so the header loses the bar A1 names.
evidence: internal/cli/watch_view.go:256-258; live 120x40 frame: '53/56 ticks · 5d3h · ● stopped: the Workflow instance is complete and the run record says stopped' with no bar
